main_visual_task: A playful morning wake-up game in one continuous bedside view: the woman lies prone on top of the man, face to face, coaxing him to get up for brunch while he pretends to sleep; her tactics escalate from face taps to a nose pinch until he pretends to give in — both laughing softly the whole time.
